Frontend canvas rendering verified with procedural pixel-art system working correctly. Critical gameplay features tested: building placement with correct cash deduction, building selection with proper hitbox alignment, overlay toggles functional. No console errors or React rendering issues detected. The pixel-art renderer rewrite (renderer.js, pixel.js, creatures.js, buildings.js, staff.js) introduced NO functional regressions in UI/gameplay layer.
